title: How a self-driving car decides what to do
examples: How does a self-driving car make decisions?
How does a driverless car predict what people will do?
What are the levels of self-driving?

stages.label: Sense
stages.note: Cameras, radar and lidar scan all around, many times a second.

stages.label: Perceive
stages.note: Software spots cars, people, lanes and traffic lights.
stages.ask: How does a self-driving car recognise things?

stages.label: Predict
stages.note: It guesses where each car and person will move next.
stages.ask: How does a self-driving car predict what others will do?

stages.label: Plan
stages.note: It picks a safe path and speed for the next few seconds.

stages.label: Act
stages.note: It steers, brakes and accelerates, then senses again.
stages.ask: How does a self-driving car control the wheel?

explain.say: A self-driving car runs the same loop over and over, many times a second: sense, perceive, predict, plan and act. Each lap uses fresh information about the road.

explain.say: Its cameras, radar and lidar produce a flood of data, and software trained on huge numbers of examples picks out cars, cyclists, people, lane lines and traffic lights.

faq.q: How does a self-driving car recognise things?
faq.a: It uses neural networks trained on millions of labelled images and sensor scans. They learn to pick out cars, pedestrians, cyclists, signs and lane markings in what the sensors see.
asks: How does an autonomous car see people?

faq.q: How does a self-driving car predict what others will do?
faq.a: It tracks each moving object's speed and direction and uses models learned from huge amounts of driving data to estimate several likely paths for each one.
asks: Can a driverless car guess what a cyclist will do?

faq.q: How does a self-driving car control the wheel?
faq.a: Its computer sends electronic commands to motors that turn the steering, apply the brakes and set the power, which is called drive-by-wire.

faq.q: How often does a self-driving car make decisions?
faq.a: Its loop runs many times every second, so it can react to changes very quickly and keep updating its plan.
asks: How fast does a self-driving car react?

faq.q: What are the levels of self-driving?
faq.a: Engineers use levels from 0, no automation, to 5, a car that can drive itself anywhere. Most cars today offer driver assistance at levels 1 or 2, where a human must watch the road all the time.

facts: SAE International defines six levels of driving automation, from Level 0 to Level 5.
Waymo offers fully driverless paid robotaxi rides to the public, starting in Phoenix, Arizona.

quiz.say: In the self-driving loop, what comes straight after predicting what others will do?
quiz.why: Once it knows what others will probably do, it plans a path and speed that stays safe.

wrong.1: Sensing starts the loop; after predicting comes planning.
wrong.2: Turning off is not part of the driving loop.
